_comment: Strings written into EVERY language slot, not just the one we replace. The language picker must advertise Ukrainian in whatever language the console currently runs, otherwise a German or Russian user has no way to know that 'English' now leads to Ukrainian. Everything else in those slots stays in its own language. Keys mirror src/strings/<title>/<key>.json; labels are looked up per slot.
